scope: Independent implementation review and isolated tests only. No real credential reads, target scan, network calls or target Git writes by this reviewer.
confirmedAndFixed: The raw Git archive method could omit or substitute blobs. The replacement enumerates and validates raw Git blobs.
Known values in tar PAX metadata could escape member-only scanning. The replacement includes decoded container bytes.
Gitleaks exit 1 with an empty report could pass. The replacement rejects inconsistent status and report results.
The blob reader did not close its stdout pipe. Cleanup now closes both handles.
additionalCheck: A recovery directory owned by another user is rejected before its JSON files are read.
portableTests: The test script loads the helper beside it. It uses only disposable synthetic inputs under /tmp.

checks: The canonical key value is included in known-value patterns.
A present legacy alias value is also included.
An absent legacy alias is accepted when the canonical key is present.
Each required key is checked separately. The legacy alias cannot satisfy the canonical key requirement.

priorReview.status: Superseded for Steam key coverage. The previous implementation required the legacy key name and missed the canonical key.
